title: Translate an education-only pack's docs (reviewed)
context: Translating the education-only cancer gene tutorial (edu-019) into additional languages widens its reach to non-English-speaking patient advocates and students. Because the source content is patient-facing and riskTier: high, any translation must carry the same not-medical-advice framing and requires oncologist + patient-advocate review in the target language before publication. No specific language has been chosen yet — this task is contingent on identifying a review-qualified translator and reviewers for the target language.
objective: Translate the education-only cancer gene tutorial into one target language, with oncologist + patient-advocate sign-off in that language before publication, and not-medical-advice notice present in the translated text.
acceptanceCriteria: A specific target language is identified with a qualified translator and target-language oncologist + patient-advocate reviewers confirmed before translation begins.
Translated tutorial carries the same education-only framing and a prominent not-medical-advice notice as the source document.
Oncologist sign-off AND patient-advocate sign-off in the target language are both recorded in a committed review artifact before the translation is published.
Translation does not introduce new medical claims or reframe research findings as clinical guidance.
Document output licensed CC-BY-4.0; commit is DCO signed-off.
output: docs/edu-tutorial-cancer-genes.<lang>.md — translated education-only tutorial with not-medical-advice notice and target-language review sign-off artifact.
